_comment: Provenance for every tuned fused_moe config on the bench box, under
/mnt/llm-storage/bench-matrix/. Six directories accumulated with no record of
which was for which shape, what it measured, or whether it should ever load.
READ deploy BEFORE USING ANY OF THESE. Two of them measured WORSE than the
untuned heuristic and one was generated under the wrong dtype scheme entirely.
HOW vLLM PICKS A FILE: it opens exactly
inside VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER, checked BEFORE the shipped configs. A file
whose name lacks the dtype tag is never opened -- docs/41 lost 7.5 GPU-hours
to exactly that. serve_vllm_aiter.sh leaves VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER empty by
default, so nothing here loads unless a round sets it.
NEAREST-M HAS NO FALLBACK. A shape larger than the biggest tuned M matches the
nearest tuned entry, so a config covering only decode sizes will be applied to
prefill. That is how the int8 config below reached 0.786x prefill.

configs.reason: Slower than untuned on every metric. Cause is the M gap, not the tuning: M=64/128 are absent and nearest-M matching sent prefill shapes to a decode config. ~5.5 GPU-hours.

Decode flat at the tuned size (round 78), inside the 1.036x noise floor. Prefill regression is the expected cost of covering only M=1,2. The sweep was stopped here: candidate counts double per M, so M>=32 exceeds a 3 h cap and the full sweep would have cost ~8 GPU-hours to reach a config with the same M-gap defect as the int8 one above.
Working file for round 77's per-size merge, not a loadable config -- the filename does not match what vLLM opens. Source of truth for moe-int4-deploy/.
One file per tuned size, kept because benchmark_moe.py writes the whole file at the end of a run and a crash discards everything (docs/41 lost three sizes to a Ray worker death).

Generated with --dtype auto, which benchmarks a DIFFERENT kernel. Its schema differs too -- it carries matrix_instr_nonkdim and kpack, which the int8_w8a16 config does not have at all. Deliberately NOT renamed: a config produced under the wrong scheme is worse than none. ~7.5 GPU-hours.
Untagged dtype, so vLLM never opens it. N=768 means TP=1, a shape nothing here serves. Single M. Superseded by moe-configs-merged/.
Untagged dtype, so vLLM never opens it. TP=1 shape. Predates the filename finding in docs/41.
Directory exists with no JSON files.

summary.note: Every tuned MoE config produced on this hardware has measured neutral or worse. Nothing here should be deployed, and nothing here should be offered upstream -- contributing a 0.786x config would push a regression onto other MI210 users.
